# KytyPS5 Yōtei fork

An experimental fork of [KytyPS5](https://github.com/KytyPS5/KytyPS5) (based on [Kyty](https://github.com/InoriRus/Kyty))
that targets **one game only: Ghost of Yōtei (PS5)**, version 1.512. It contains **no game files**: you need your own
dump of the game.

- **Download:** [Releases](https://github.com/Erlou93/KytyPS5-Yotei/releases): one zip with the launcher, the emulator,
  the game's shader hints and a step-by-step player guide (PDF).
- **Start here:** [README-YOTEI.md](../README-YOTEI.md): playing, what to expect, known issues and their workarounds,
  building.
- **Report a problem:** [Issues](https://github.com/Erlou93/KytyPS5-Yotei/issues): attach the zip from the launcher's
  Advanced → Export bug report.
- **Developers:** [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md),
  [docs/FIXES.md](../docs/FIXES.md), [docs/PERFORMANCE.md](../docs/PERFORMANCE.md).

The upstream KytyPS5 README is kept unchanged as [README.md](../README.md). Licences: [LICENSE](../LICENSE) and
[LICENSES](../LICENSES).
